name: Tomislav Furlanis
backstory: LOTR and Greg Bear's Eon started my golden-age sci-fi childhood at nine and high school sparked my first PC game design attempts. Two decades followed absorbed in Forgotten Realms, TTRPGs, and Extra Credits. Now, armed with research in narrative theories, degrees in humanities and packed insights from the real and fictional worlds, I manifest my passion for embodied games—a profound art that uniquely expresses embodied human experience beyond any other medium.
